description: Returns the caption transcript of one YouTube video as text with [seconds] timestamps, plus segments_count; text is capped at 12,000 characters (truncated and total_chars say whether it was cut). Use it when the video ID is known. It does not find videos (use search_youtube) and does not translate captions. 5 credits per successful call. Required: video_id.

country.description: Two-letter country code the transcript is requested from, e.g. "us" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter code of the caption language wanted, e.g. "en" or "it"; captions are not translated. Omit for the source default, en.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID, the v= value of a watch URL, e.g. "jNQXAC9IVRw".

name: youtube_transcript
title: YouTube Transcript
